# Status: syntax checked only; not compiled or run on a GPU here.
import torch
import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T


@tilelang.jit(target="cuda")
def make_softmax(M, N):
    assert M > 0 and 1 <= N <= 4096
    BLOCK = 1 << (N - 1).bit_length()

    @T.prim_func
    def main(X: T.Tensor((M, N), "float32"),
             Y: T.Tensor((M, N), "float32")):
        with T.Kernel(M, threads=128) as row:
            values = T.alloc_fragment((1, BLOCK), "float32")
            maximum = T.alloc_fragment((1,), "float32")
            denominator = T.alloc_fragment((1,), "float32")
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                values[0, j] = T.if_then_else(
                    j < N, X[row, j], -T.infinity("float32"))
            T.reduce_max(values, maximum, dim=1)
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                values[0, j] = T.exp(values[0, j] - maximum[0])
            T.reduce_sum(values, denominator, dim=1)
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                if j < N:
                    Y[row, j] = values[0, j] / denominator[0]
    return main


def check(M, N):
    assert torch.cuda.is_available()
    x = (torch.randn((M, N), device="cuda") * 10).contiguous()
    x[0].fill_(1000.0)
    if M > 1:
        x[1].add_(1000.0)
    y = torch.empty_like(x)
    make_softmax(M, N)(x, y)
    torch.testing.assert_close(y, torch.softmax(x, -1),
                               rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-6)
    torch.testing.assert_close(y.sum(-1), torch.ones(M, device="cuda"),
                               rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5)
    print(f"passed: M={M}, N={N}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    for n in (1, 127, 1024, 4095):
        check(32, n)

# Status: syntax checked only; not compiled or run on a GPU here.
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T


@tilelang.jit(target="cuda")
def make_layernorm(M, N, EPS=1e-5):
    assert M > 0 and 1 <= N <= 4096 and EPS > 0
    BLOCK = 1 << (N - 1).bit_length()

    @T.prim_func
    def main(X: T.Tensor((M, N), "float32"),
             G: T.Tensor((N,), "float32"),
             B: T.Tensor((N,), "float32"),
             Y: T.Tensor((M, N), "float32")):
        with T.Kernel(M, threads=128) as row:
            values = T.alloc_fragment((1, BLOCK), "float32")
            centered_sq = T.alloc_fragment((1, BLOCK), "float32")
            total = T.alloc_fragment((1,), "float32")
            mean = T.alloc_fragment((1,), "float32")
            variance = T.alloc_fragment((1,), "float32")
            invstd = T.alloc_fragment((1,), "float32")
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                values[0, j] = T.if_then_else(j < N, X[row, j], 0.0)
            T.reduce_sum(values, total, dim=1)
            for r in T.Parallel(1):
                mean[r] = total[r] / N
            # Second statistical pass: centered squared differences.
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                centered_sq[0, j] = T.if_then_else(
                    j < N, (values[0, j] - mean[0]) * (values[0, j] - mean[0]), 0.0)
            T.reduce_sum(centered_sq, variance, dim=1)
            for r in T.Parallel(1):
                invstd[r] = T.rsqrt(variance[r] / N + EPS)
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                if j < N:
                    Y[row, j] = ((values[0, j] - mean[0])
                                 * invstd[0] * G[j] + B[j])
    return main


def check(N, offset):
    M, eps = 32, 1e-5
    x = (torch.randn((M, N), device="cuda") + offset).contiguous()
    x[0].fill_(offset)
    gamma = torch.randn(N, device="cuda")
    beta = torch.randn(N, device="cuda")
    y = torch.empty_like(x)
    make_layernorm(M, N, eps)(x, gamma, beta, y)
    ref = F.layer_norm(x, (N,), gamma, beta, eps)
    torch.testing.assert_close(y, ref, rtol=3e-4, atol=3e-4)
    print(f"passed: N={N}, offset={offset}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert torch.cuda.is_available()
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    for n in (1, 255, 1024, 4095):
        check(n, 0.0)
        check(n, 100.0)

# Status: syntax checked only; not compiled or run on a GPU here.
import torch
import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T


@tilelang.jit(target="cuda")
def make_rmsnorm(M, N, EPS=1e-6):
    assert M > 0 and 1 <= N <= 4096 and EPS > 0
    BLOCK = 1 << (N - 1).bit_length()

    @T.prim_func
    def main(X: T.Tensor((M, N), "float32"),
             W: T.Tensor((N,), "float32"),
             Y: T.Tensor((M, N), "float32")):
        with T.Kernel(M, threads=128) as row:
            values = T.alloc_fragment((1, BLOCK), "float32")
            squares = T.alloc_fragment((1, BLOCK), "float32")
            square_sum = T.alloc_fragment((1,), "float32")
            inv_rms = T.alloc_fragment((1,), "float32")
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                values[0, j] = T.if_then_else(j < N, X[row, j], 0.0)
                squares[0, j] = values[0, j] * values[0, j]
            T.reduce_sum(squares, square_sum, dim=1)
            for r in T.Parallel(1):
                inv_rms[r] = T.rsqrt(square_sum[r] / N + EPS)
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                if j < N:
                    Y[row, j] = values[0, j] * inv_rms[0] * W[j]
    return main


def reference(x, weight, eps):
    scale = torch.rsqrt(x.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    return x * scale * weight


def check(N):
    M, eps = 32, 1e-6
    x = torch.randn((M, N), device="cuda")
    x[0].zero_()
    weight = torch.randn(N, device="cuda")
    y = torch.empty_like(x)
    make_rmsnorm(M, N, eps)(x, weight, y)
    torch.testing.assert_close(y, reference(x, weight, eps),
                               rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5)
    print(f"passed: N={N}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert torch.cuda.is_available()
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    for n in (1, 255, 1024, 4095):
        check(n)

# Status: syntax checked only; not compiled or run on a GPU here.
import torch
import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T


@tilelang.jit(target="cuda")
def make_residual_rmsnorm(M, N, EPS=1e-6):
    assert M > 0 and 1 <= N <= 4096 and EPS > 0
    BLOCK = 1 << (N - 1).bit_length()

    @T.prim_func
    def main(X: T.Tensor((M, N), "float32"),
             R: T.Tensor((M, N), "float32"),
             W: T.Tensor((N,), "float32"),
             Y: T.Tensor((M, N), "float32")):
        with T.Kernel(M, threads=128) as row:
            combined = T.alloc_fragment((1, BLOCK), "float32")
            squares = T.alloc_fragment((1, BLOCK), "float32")
            square_sum = T.alloc_fragment((1,), "float32")
            inv_rms = T.alloc_fragment((1,), "float32")
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                combined[0, j] = T.if_then_else(
                    j < N, X[row, j] + R[row, j], 0.0)
                squares[0, j] = combined[0, j] * combined[0, j]
            T.reduce_sum(squares, square_sum, dim=1)
            for r in T.Parallel(1):
                inv_rms[r] = T.rsqrt(square_sum[r] / N + EPS)
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                if j < N:
                    Y[row, j] = combined[0, j] * inv_rms[0] * W[j]
    return main


def check(M=32, N=1023):
    eps = 1e-6
    x = torch.randn((M, N), device="cuda")
    residual = torch.randn_like(x)
    weight = torch.randn(N, device="cuda")
    y = torch.empty_like(x)
    make_residual_rmsnorm(M, N, eps)(x, residual, weight, y)
    u = x + residual
    ref = u * torch.rsqrt(u.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    ref = ref * weight
    torch.testing.assert_close(y, ref, rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5)
    print("residual RMSNorm passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert torch.cuda.is_available()
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    check()

# Status: syntax checked only; not compiled or run on a GPU here.
import torch
import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T


@tilelang.jit(target="cuda")
def make_rope(S, D, interleaved=True, BLOCK=256):
    assert S > 0 and D > 0 and D % 2 == 0
    HALF = D // 2
    STEP = 2 if interleaved else 1
    OFFSET = 1 if interleaved else HALF

    @T.prim_func
    def main(X: T.Tensor((S, D), "float32"),
             Cos: T.Tensor((S, HALF), "float32"),
             Sin: T.Tensor((S, HALF), "float32"),
             Y: T.Tensor((S, D), "float32")):
        with T.Kernel(T.ceildiv(S * HALF, BLOCK), threads=128) as bx:
            for lane in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                pair = bx * BLOCK + lane
                if pair < S * HALF:
                    row = pair // HALF
                    j = pair % HALF
                    ia = j * STEP
                    ib = ia + OFFSET
                    a = X[row, ia]
                    b = X[row, ib]
                    c = Cos[row, j]
                    s = Sin[row, j]
                    Y[row, ia] = a * c - b * s
                    Y[row, ib] = a * s + b * c
    return main


def reference(x, cos, sin, interleaved):
    if interleaved:
        a, b = x[:, 0::2], x[:, 1::2]
        return torch.stack((a * cos - b * sin,
                            a * sin + b * cos), dim=-1).flatten(-2)
    a, b = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
    return torch.cat((a * cos - b * sin, a * sin + b * cos), -1)


def check(S=17, D=64):
    x = torch.randn((S, D), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
    position = torch.arange(S, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
    j = torch.arange(D // 2, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
    inverse_frequency = torch.pow(10000.0, -2.0 * j / D)
    angle = position[:, None] * inverse_frequency[None, :]
    cos, sin = angle.cos().contiguous(), angle.sin().contiguous()
    for interleaved in (True, False):
        y = torch.empty_like(x)
        make_rope(S, D, interleaved)(x, cos, sin, y)
        ref = reference(x, cos, sin, interleaved)
        torch.testing.assert_close(y, ref, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)
        torch.testing.assert_close(y.square().sum(-1), x.square().sum(-1),
                                   rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5)
        print(f"passed: interleaved={interleaved}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert torch.cuda.is_available()
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    check()

statement: 实现分阶段、非 causal scaled dot-product attention：QKᵀ 写出分数矩阵，逐行 Softmax 写出概率矩阵，最后乘 V。三个阶段全部使用 TileLang。保留 S×S 中间量以方便验证与比较下一题；naive 指计算图分阶段，不要求使用标量点积。
formula: Scores=QKᵀ/√D；P=Softmax(Scores)；O=PV；P 转为 FP16 后参与第二次 GEMM。
inputs: Q、K、V: [S,D]，连续 float16 CUDA 张量；B=H=1，D=64。
outputs: O: [S,D] float16；临时 Scores[S,S] 为 FP32、P[S,S] 为 FP16。
constraints: 面向 NVIDIA SM80+，需要 CUDA 与 TileLang Tensor Core 编译链。
非 causal、无 dropout；不支持任意 mask、GQA/MQA、paged KV、变长序列或 backward。
GEMM 输入 FP16、累加 FP32；概率转 FP16 是显式精度边界，不等同于全 FP32 attention。
已核对官方 API 并通过 Python 语法检查；本环境未安装 TileLang/PyTorch，未进行 GPU 编译、正确性运行或性能实测。

Softmax 一行一个 block，在 FP32 fragment 中稳定归一化，写出 FP16 概率。
PV 沿 S 维以 64 分块；共享内存加载 P/V，FP32 累加，最后转 FP16 输出。

# Status: syntax checked only; not compiled or run on a GPU here.
# B=H=1, D=64, S divisible by 64, non-causal, FP16 Q/K/V.
import torch
import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T


@tilelang.jit(target="cuda")
def make_qk(S, D=64):
    assert 0 < S <= 2048 and S % 64 == 0 and D == 64
    @T.prim_func
    def main(Q: T.Tensor((S, D), "float16"),
             K: T.Tensor((S, D), "float16"),
             Scores: T.Tensor((S, S), "float32")):
        with T.Kernel(S // 64, S // 64, threads=128) as (kc, qr):
            qs = T.alloc_shared((64, D), "float16")
            ks = T.alloc_shared((64, D), "float16")
            acc = T.alloc_fragment((64, 64), "float32")
            T.copy(Q[qr * 64, 0], qs)
            T.copy(K[kc * 64, 0], ks)
            T.clear(acc)
            T.gemm(qs, ks, acc, transpose_B=True)
            for i, j in T.Parallel(64, 64):
                acc[i, j] *= D ** -0.5
            T.copy(acc, Scores[qr * 64, kc * 64])
    return main


@tilelang.jit(target="cuda")
def make_probability(S):
    assert 0 < S <= 2048 and S % 64 == 0
    BLOCK = 1 << (S - 1).bit_length()
    @T.prim_func
    def main(Scores: T.Tensor((S, S), "float32"),
             P: T.Tensor((S, S), "float16")):
        with T.Kernel(S, threads=128) as row:
            v = T.alloc_fragment((1, BLOCK), "float32")
            m = T.alloc_fragment((1,), "float32")
            z = T.alloc_fragment((1,), "float32")
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                v[0, j] = T.if_then_else(
                    j < S, Scores[row, j], -T.infinity("float32"))
            T.reduce_max(v, m, dim=1)
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                v[0, j] = T.exp(v[0, j] - m[0])
            T.reduce_sum(v, z, dim=1)
            for j in T.Parallel(BLOCK):
                if j < S:
                    P[row, j] = v[0, j] / z[0]
    return main


@tilelang.jit(target="cuda")
def make_pv(S, D=64):
    assert 0 < S <= 2048 and S % 64 == 0 and D == 64
    @T.prim_func
    def main(P: T.Tensor((S, S), "float16"),
             V: T.Tensor((S, D), "float16"),
             O: T.Tensor((S, D), "float16")):
        with T.Kernel(S // 64, threads=128) as qr:
            ps = T.alloc_shared((64, 64), "float16")
            vs = T.alloc_shared((64, D), "float16")
            acc = T.alloc_fragment((64, D), "float32")
            T.clear(acc)
            for tile in T.Pipelined(S // 64, num_stages=1):
                T.copy(P[qr * 64, tile * 64], ps)
                T.copy(V[tile * 64, 0], vs)
                T.gemm(ps, vs, acc)
            T.copy(acc, O[qr * 64, 0])
    return main


def check(S=256, D=64):
    assert torch.cuda.is_available()
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
    assert torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] >= 8, "Use SM80+"
    q, k, v = [torch.randn((S, D), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float16)
               for _ in range(3)]
    scores = torch.empty((S, S), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
    p = torch.empty((S, S), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float16)
    out = torch.empty_like(q)
    qk, sm, pv = make_qk(S, D), make_probability(S), make_pv(S, D)
    qk(q, k, scores)
    sm(scores, p)
    pv(p, v, out)
    ref_scores = q.float() @ k.float().T / (D ** 0.5)
    ref_p = torch.softmax(ref_scores, dim=-1)
    # Match the explicit FP16 probability boundary.
    ref_out = (ref_p.half().float() @ v.float()).half()
    torch.testing.assert_close(scores, ref_scores, rtol=2e-3, atol=2e-3)
    torch.testing.assert_close(p.float(), ref_p, rtol=2e-3, atol=2e-4)
    torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref_out, rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2)
    print("three-stage attention passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    check()

versions.note: 完整脚本；依据官方示例原理简化为单 batch/head、固定维度、串行 tile 循环。FP32 参考用于容差比较，不声称逐位一致。已核对官方 API 并通过 Python 语法检查；本环境未安装 TileLang/PyTorch，未进行 GPU 编译、正确性运行或性能实测。

# Status: syntax checked only; not compiled or run on a GPU here.
# B=H=1, D=64, S divisible by 64, non-causal, NVIDIA SM80+.
import torch
import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T


@tilelang.jit(target="cuda")
def make_flash_attention(S, D=64):
    assert S > 0 and S % 64 == 0 and D == 64
    BM, BN = 64, 64
    SCALE = D ** -0.5

    @T.prim_func
    def main(Q: T.Tensor((S, D), "float16"),
             K: T.Tensor((S, D), "float16"),
             V: T.Tensor((S, D), "float16"),
             O: T.Tensor((S, D), "float16")):
        with T.Kernel(S // BM, threads=128) as qb:
            qs = T.alloc_shared((BM, D), "float16")
            ks = T.alloc_shared((BN, D), "float16")
            vs = T.alloc_shared((BN, D), "float16")
            ps = T.alloc_shared((BM, BN), "float16")
            score = T.alloc_fragment((BM, BN), "float32")
            out = T.alloc_fragment((BM, D), "float32")
            running_m = T.alloc_fragment((BM,), "float32")
            running_l = T.alloc_fragment((BM,), "float32")
            merged_m = T.alloc_fragment((BM,), "float32")
            tile_l = T.alloc_fragment((BM,), "float32")
            alpha = T.alloc_fragment((BM,), "float32")
            T.copy(Q[qb * BM, 0], qs)
            T.clear(out)
            T.clear(running_l)
            T.fill(running_m, -T.infinity("float32"))
            # Serial loop exposes dependencies of the online state.
            for kv in T.serial(S // BN):
                T.copy(K[kv * BN, 0], ks)
                T.copy(V[kv * BN, 0], vs)
                T.clear(score)
                T.gemm(qs, ks, score, transpose_B=True,
                       policy=T.GemmWarpPolicy.FullRow)
                for i, j in T.Parallel(BM, BN):
                    score[i, j] *= SCALE
                T.reduce_max(score, merged_m, dim=1)
                for i in T.Parallel(BM):
                    merged_m[i] = T.max(running_m[i], merged_m[i])
                    alpha[i] = T.exp(running_m[i] - merged_m[i])
                for i, j in T.Parallel(BM, BN):
                    score[i, j] = T.exp(score[i, j] - merged_m[i])
                T.reduce_sum(score, tile_l, dim=1)
                for i in T.Parallel(BM):
                    running_l[i] = alpha[i] * running_l[i] + tile_l[i]
                    running_m[i] = merged_m[i]
                # Rescale the old numerator BEFORE adding this tile.
                for i, d in T.Parallel(BM, D):
                    out[i, d] *= alpha[i]
                T.copy(score, ps)  # FP32 weights -> FP16 GEMM input.
                T.gemm(ps, vs, out, policy=T.GemmWarpPolicy.FullRow)
            for i, d in T.Parallel(BM, D):
                out[i, d] /= running_l[i]
            T.copy(out, O[qb * BM, 0])
    return main


def check(S=256, D=64):
    assert torch.cuda.is_available()
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
    assert torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] >= 8, "Use SM80+"
    q, k, v = [torch.randn((S, D), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float16)
               for _ in range(3)]
    out = torch.empty_like(q)
    make_flash_attention(S, D)(q, k, v, out)
    logits = (q.float() @ k.float().T) / (D ** 0.5)
    ref = (torch.softmax(logits, -1) @ v.float()).half()
    # FP16 unnormalized tile weights are an approximation boundary.
    torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref, rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2)
    assert torch.isfinite(out).all()
    print("online attention passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    check(64)
    check(256)

pitfalls.title: 只更新分母不够
pitfalls.body: 最大值变为 m′ 时，旧分母 l 和旧分子 A 都要乘 exp(m−m′)；漏掉其中一个会改变最终比值。

pitfalls.title: 不能逐块归一化后直接相加
pitfalls.body: 局部 Softmax 各自除以局部分母后相加，不等于全局 Softmax。应累加共同基准下的未归一化分子，最后除一次。

pitfalls.title: 概率 FP16 边界
pitfalls.body: 分母按 FP32 求和，第二次 GEMM 的权重为 FP16。应实测误差，不能把容差检查描述为逐位等价。

questions.q: 为什么不再需要 S² 空间？
questions.a: 分数与概率只保留当前 BM×BN tile，行状态为 BM，输出累加器为 BM×D；全局只需输入与输出。

按 query/key 全局位置屏蔽未来 key 并限制遍历范围；还要处理尾部、全掩码行、−Inf 指数差，不能只给输出乘三角 mask。
